title: The 4 Best Panini Presses and Sandwich Makers for Small Kitchens
h1: The 4 Best Panini Presses and Sandwich Makers for Small Kitchens
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for panini presses and sandwich makers for small kitchens, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at panini presses and sandwich makers for small kitchens using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Proctor Silex Deluxe Hot Sandwich Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: Fits 2 sandwiches at once, Ceramic nonstick plates, Compact upright storage.
strengths: Smallest footprint in this category, stores upright on its edge
Lightweight enough to lift in and out of a cabinet one-handed
Cheapest option, easy to justify in a kitchen with tight budget and tight space
limitations: Smaller plate area than the other two picks
Fixed clamshell gap, no adjustable pressure

products.name: Hamilton Beach Panini Press 25460A
products.blurb: Key specs: Floating hinge opens 180 degrees, 8-inch by 10-inch nonstick grids, Locking latch for storage.
strengths: 180-degree opening doubles as a flat grill, adding function without adding a second appliance
Still stores upright with a locking latch, comparable footprint to the Proctor Silex
Larger plates than the Proctor Silex without a significant size penalty in storage
limitations: Heavier than the Proctor Silex, slightly more awkward to store one-handed
Grids aren't removable for deep cleaning

products.name: Cuisinart Griddler Deluxe GR-150
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-in-1 grill, griddle, and panini functions, Reversible nonstick plates, Floating hinge.
strengths: Replaces a separate grill, griddle, and panini press, a net space saving if you'd otherwise own all three
Reversible plates mean one unit switches roles instead of storing multiple appliances
Best resale and versatility value if the kitchen might grow into more cooking down the line
limitations: Largest footprint of the three, both in storage and on the counter during use
Doesn't store upright the way the other two do
Overkill if sandwiches are genuinely the only use case

products.name: DASH Mini Maker Portable Grill Machine and Panini Press
strengths: Easy to store in a drawer
limitations: Makes one item at a time

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
